paper.title: Thoughts to Target: Enhance Planning for Target-driven Conversation

limitations: the public repository contains data but no executable EnPL implementation
released records do not identify the authors' final selected candidates or data splits
top-two selection over 5541 released records cannot reproduce the paper's 12147-plan count
TextRank implementation and several generation settings are not specified
domain-conditioned entity retrieval is an explicit adaptation of the paper's movie-overlap heuristic
